race.comment: DIRTY HABITS (8) raced over 1300m last week where he showed his class, closing strongly off a freshen to be 1.5L off the winner. Out to the mile now is a big tick and he maps for a lovely run with Nottle's claim a bonus. He's a very progressive type who can bounce back to winning ways. THE ROCKET (3) has bolted in at his past couple since being sent forward, leading and running away with a 2.2L win over 1400m. Now out to the mile, he can work across from the wide draw and dictate from the front. He'll be very hard to run down. YES I KNOW (1) has been narrowly beaten his past couple, missing in a photo finish last start when looking the winner with 100m to run. He rates highly on his recent form and CJP sticks with him. Drawn better this time and can go one better. STREAK OF GOD (7) ran over the top to score over 1650m here last time out and can repeat the dose without surprising. COSMIC GEM (6) bolted in last start and can't be discounted.
